verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice documents automations such as payment reminders, scheduled invoice sending, recurring invoices and quote-to-invoice conversion, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review/approval of changes, or rollback for those automation rules. The approval mentioned for quotes is customer quote acceptance, an adjacent feature rather than review of automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
